title: Concept: Process listing returned in a response
description: A process table with PIDs and command lines in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Command lines carry arguments, and arguments carry the paths, hosts and sometimes credentials the process was started with, which is a ready-made pivot list.
applicability: Deployments that render a process table with PIDs and command lines into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Command lines carry arguments, and arguments carry the paths, hosts and sometimes credentials the process was started with, which is a ready-made pivot list.
